title: Password Grabber
summary: A message that tries to get you to say your password out loud or type it in.
example: A text says: "Hi, I am from Moonbeam Games support. Tell me your password so I can fix your account."
howToSpot: Real helpers never ask for your password. They also hurry you up.
whatToDo: Do not share it. Tell a grown-up, then block and report the sender.
